openers: Ah! A new head. [[slnc 300]] Let me have a look inside.

questions: Would you rather be brave, clever, kind, or powerful?
If you found a secret door in the castle, what would you do?
Which would you choose as a pet? A lion, an eagle, a badger, or a snake?
If you could have any magical power at all, what would it be?
What do you love to do more than anything else?
What do you want people to remember you for?
Which would you take on a quest? A sword, a book, a friend, or a treasure map?

If you were a teacher at a school of magic, what would you teach?
Your friend is in trouble. What do you do?
Which would you rather win? A race, a quiz, a prize for kindness, or a golden crown?
What is the most important thing a wizard should have?
If you could explore anywhere in the whole world, where would you go?
Which would you rather have? A flying broom, an invisibility cloak, a magic book, or a basket of treats?
